resources.string: Microphone and phone to record calls. Call log and contacts to show who you talked to.
Since Android 10, only an accessibility service can use the microphone during a call. In Accessibility → Installed apps, open “CallRecorder Helper” and turn it on. It reads nothing on your screen.
For apps installed outside the Play Store, open the app info, tap ⋮ in the top corner, then “Allow restricted settings”.
Prevents the system from stopping the service to save battery (recommended on Samsung, Xiaomi, Huawei…).
Your recordings are listened to, searched and organised in the CallRecorder app.
This app is required for CallRecorder to work: it records your calls and hands them over to the app.
The Helper only talks to the CallRecorder app on this phone. It has no internet access: your calls never leave your phone.
Allows CallRecorder Helper to use the microphone during calls (required since Android 10). This service reads no screen content.
The recording will stop when you hang up
The microphone is unavailable. Check the setup.
Install or open the CallRecorder app to listen to it.
